line: ; Observatory queue processor used to exercise the Fennel grammar.
ruleStack: [(1, source.fnl, source.fnl)]

line: ; Unicode labels: naïve café, Διάστημα, 世界; astral symbols: 🔭 🛰️ 🌌.
ruleStack: [(1, source.fnl, source.fnl)]

line: ; Operators submit comma-separated right ascension, declination, exposure, repeat, and filter fields through load-targets.
ruleStack: [(1, source.fnl, source.fnl)]

line: ; normalize-target applies conservative defaults so partially entered queue records remain safe to inspect before scheduling.
ruleStack: [(1, source.fnl, source.fnl)]

line: ; Coordinates are represented in decimal degrees; callers perform hour-angle conversion before constructing target tables.
ruleStack: [(1, source.fnl, source.fnl)]

line: ; The in-memory logger deliberately implements the same write method as an ordinary Lua file handle for dependency injection.
ruleStack: [(1, source.fnl, source.fnl)]

line: ; Scheduling ignores maintenance records while retaining their position, which keeps imported observing plans reproducible.
ruleStack: [(1, source.fnl, source.fnl)]

line: ; Exposure totals include repeats but omit readout overhead; the production service adds camera-specific timing afterward.
ruleStack: [(1, source.fnl, source.fnl)]

line: ; Signal quality is acceptable only when a sample is neither saturated nor faint and exceeds five times the measured noise.
ruleStack: [(1, source.fnl, source.fnl)]

line: ; Bit masks reserve the upper byte for a detector channel and the lower byte for calibration and acquisition status flags.
ruleStack: [(1, source.fnl, source.fnl)]

line: ; Pagination uses floor division and remainder so command-line summaries can show complete pages and a partial final page.
ruleStack: [(1, source.fnl, source.fnl)]

line: ; Threading macros keep the report pipeline readable while optional threading safely traverses absent observer addresses.
ruleStack: [(1, source.fnl, source.fnl)]

line: ; choose-action demonstrates structural matching over weather and dome state without coupling the scheduler to UI strings.
ruleStack: [(1, source.fnl, source.fnl)]

line: ; wait-until cooperatively yields instead of sleeping, allowing telescope, enclosure, and weather coroutines to share a loop.
ruleStack: [(1, source.fnl, source.fnl)]

line: ; guarded-call normalizes protected-call results into a value/error pair suitable for logs and unattended retry decisions.
ruleStack: [(1, source.fnl, source.fnl)]

line: ; Status updates mutate one shared table intentionally because monitoring clients retain references to the active run state.
ruleStack: [(1, source.fnl, source.fnl)]

line: ; sorted-copy preserves incoming target order while producing deterministic reports for operators and golden-file reviews.
ruleStack: [(1, source.fnl, source.fnl)]

line: ; Demo records include emission-nebula, cluster, and maintenance entries with realistic coordinates and exposure durations.
ruleStack: [(1, source.fnl, source.fnl)]

line: ; The report string spans physical lines to exercise multiline string state, escaped quotes, tabs, and a terminal backslash.
ruleStack: [(1, source.fnl, source.fnl)]

line: ; Assertions document fixture invariants and also cover equality, comparison, member access, function calls, and literals.
ruleStack: [(1, source.fnl, source.fnl)]

line: ; This corpus favors representative observatory code over generated repetition while keeping process-cold measurements stable.
ruleStack: [(1, source.fnl, source.fnl)]

line: ; End-to-end examples preserve accented, CJK, Greek, and astral text so every tokenizer path must honor UTF-8 boundaries.
